answer: Pin each identity to a place it can't fake cheaply. Each epoch, five random verifiers on different continents send every agent a fresh cipher nonce and time the signed replies. Round-trip times triangulate a rough location, so 400 personas on one rack in a basalt-walled data center share one latency fingerprint and split a single reward. To pass, a farm must host each persona on a separate network, say one per island region, paying real rent for every one. Relaying through a VPN only adds delay, which shows.
